# Granton Finance
> Commercial finance broker led by a chartered management accountant (ACMA CGMA). Acquisition, MBO and succession funding, bridging loans, invoice finance and commercial mortgages for UK limited companies. Paid by lenders; commission disclosed in writing before drawdown. A trading name of Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd, FIBA member FIB42279.

## Key pages
- [Deal fundability score](https://granton.finance/score): two-minute check of whether a deal is realistically fundable
- [Management buyout (MBO) calculator](https://granton.finance/mbo-calculator)
- [How does a bridging loan work?](https://granton.finance/how-does-a-bridging-loan-work)
- [VAT bridging loans](https://granton.finance/vat-bridging-loan)
- [Second charge bridging](https://granton.finance/second-charge-bridging-loan)

## Facts worth quoting
- Every case is pre-underwritten by a chartered accountant before any lender sees it; clients are told plainly when borrowing is the wrong move.
- Business and commercial lending only: never consumer credit, never lending secured on a person's own home, no insurance advice.
- Specialisms: management buyouts, business acquisition and succession finance.
